title: Out of the Depths I Cry to You

questions.question: Out of the depths I cry to you, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:1 (ESV): "Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord!"

questions.question: Lord, hear my voice! Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:2 (ESV): "...Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for mercy!"

questions.question: If you, O Lord, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could what?
But with you there is forgiveness, that you may be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:4 (ESV): "But with you there is forgiveness, that you may be feared."

questions.question: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, and in his word I do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:5 (ESV): "...and in his word I hope;"

questions.question: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:6 (ESV): "...more than watchmen for the morning,"

questions.question: O Israel, hope in the Lord! For with the Lord there is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:7 (ESV): "For with the Lord there is steadfast love,"

questions.question: And with him is plentiful what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:7 (ESV): "...and with him is plentiful redemption."

questions.question: And he will redeem Israel from all his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:8 (ESV): "And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities."

questions.question: Psalm 130 is one of the seven what Psalms?
questions.explanation: It is a prayer of repentance (De Profundis).

questions.question: How many times is "more than watchmen for the morning" repeated?
What is the condition for God being "feared" in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:4 (ESV): "But with you there is forgiveness, that you may be feared."

questions.question: What does the soul wait for in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalm 130:5 (ESV): "I wait for the Lord, my soul waits,"

key_verse_text: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, and in his word I hope; my soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
